note: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 67700fd37e, fc9b7f5a3b, 78f09955aa, c8e036be19, 24e7e3ae7b and 48254e243a changed maintainSA. publishSAEndpoint still runs at the top of each loop pass, the deferred saEndpoint.Store(nil) still withdraws it on every exit, and the ps.suspicious case still calls informSuspicious; the changes are reauth, address-worker and route bookkeeping. The five TestSus units are unchanged and their records are current. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-10-28 after 91502e4f4a changed maintainSA: the only change replaces ps.handleOwnedInbound with ps.handleOwnedInboundGuarded on the inbound case, a panic boundary that returns reestablish only when a panic is recovered and otherwise returns handleOwnedInbound's result. publishSAEndpoint, the deferred endpoint withdrawal and informSuspicious are untouched, and the five TestSus units are unchanged; the publishSAEndpoint mutant record was re-taken over today's maintainSA. Earlier judgement follows. Re-judged 2026-10-26 (independent judge, clean clone at c8584247bb) after a965d7c0d4 changed maintainSA. RFC 7296 Section 2.21.4: "A node receiving a suspicious message from an IP address (and port, if NAT traversal is used) with which it has an IKE SA SHOULD send an IKE Notify payload in an IKE INFORMATIONAL exchange over that SA." The only maintainSA change moves the IKE SA rekey swap (ownedSA store, retirePendingProbe, setSA, table insert/remove, forgetKeys) into the new adoptRekeyedIKESA, in the same order, adding moveVirtualIP(retired, successor) before the retired SA forgets its keys; the loop then reads sa = out.newSA as before. The Section 2.21.4 path is untouched: maintainSA still defers ps.saEndpoint.Store(nil) on every exit, publishes the SA endpoint at the top of every pass (publishSAEndpoint), so the swapped SA is published on the next pass, and answers ps.suspicious through informSuspicious on the owner goroutine under the current sa. notify_suspicious.go and rfc7296_suspicious_test.go are unchanged by the commit. The five TestSus units assert a protected INFORMATIONAL INVALID_IKE_SPI notify over the existing SA, endpoint and NAT-T port discrimination, response and IKE_SA_INIT exclusion, the rate limit, and notification from a moved endpoint through the real owner loop including endpoint withdrawal on exit; all five pass at HEAD under -race, and their five discrimination records (including the maintainSA publishSAEndpoint mutant) are current.
